_comment: Local few-sample GATHER using ReLiK's OWN pre-built index (retriever #1, RETRIEVER-ONLY, reader skipped). Same as ../20260724_local_fewshot but retriever.which='relik'. Covers BOTH 2019 + 2024 -- the runner loads each year's entity+relation index ONE AT A TIME (peak RAM = 1 year's index), so both years are fine. Needs `download_data.sh --indices` (relation) + both entity indexes at data/indices/relik_entity_index/{2019-01-01,2024-01-01} + the relik lib (env `relik`). See rebuttal_baseline.md.
